customManagers.description: Bump the pinned CLI-tool versions baked into the image Dockerfiles as ARG defaults (trufflehog, kubeconform, kube-linter, conftest). These are fetched from GitHub release tarballs, not a package registry, so the dockerfile manager can't see them — a `# renovate:` annotation above each ARG drives a github-releases lookup. extractVersion strips the leading `v` from release tags so they compare against the un-prefixed ARG value.
